adv.story.title: Story text

adv.story.run_new_btn: Make a new plan with the free AI
adv.story.run_new_title: Free AI call: rate-limited. Writes plan files.
adv.images.title: Pictures
adv.images.series_note: Series and sheets from the series file. Read-only.
adv.images.jobs_note: Job files already on disk. Image jobs are built in the wizard (step 3), not here.
adv.images.shots_note: One block per shot. Q1 to Q6 and the verdict come from the review of each candidate. Reviewer = Flow review_shot (NVIDIA).
adv.images.progress_note: Rows with no decided_by are old (written before the progress check). They are greyed out.
adv.images.collect_btn: Copy finished pictures in from Downloads
adv.images.collect_title: Copies from Downloads into final. Refuses existing outputs.
adv.images.tidy_btn: Show what would be moved (moves nothing)
adv.images.tidy_title: Dry run: shows what would move. Moves nothing.
adv.bridge.title: Key frames (from the 2K pictures)
adv.bridge.size_864: 864x1536 (not tested on sing8; about 28% more work)
adv.bridge.dry_btn: See what would be made (nothing changes)
adv.video.title: Video clips
adv.video.route_fixed: From the shot file (sing8 for LEAP)
adv.video.keyframes_ph: empty = the server default key frames folder
adv.video.res_fixed: As in the key frames folder (set in Key frames)
adv.video.prepare_btn: Get the clip group ready (no payment)
adv.video.h3_btn: Prepare the video engine files (no payment)
adv.video.colab_check_btn: Check the Colab account (contacts Google, free)
adv.video.colab_run_btn: Start a paid GPU session (costs money)
adv.video.stop_btn: Stop the work on this computer (the cloud part may keep running)
adv.video.stop_title: Kills the local process only. A paid job may keep running on Colab.

adv.export.assembly_h: How the video will be joined (not yet)
adv.export.open_title: Not available yet: no folder-open command in v1
err.srv.no_languages: Choose the video languages and press "Save my language choice" first.
err.srv.pack_finished: This plan name is already used. Use the new name {name}.
err.srv.story_exists: A story is already saved here. Tick "Replace the saved story" to replace it.
err.srv.story_too_big: The story is too long (more than about 200 KB).
err.srv.job_running: Other work is still running. Wait until it finishes.
err.srv.preview_expired: You waited too long. Press the button again.
err.srv.preview_used: This was already started. Press the button again for a new start.
err.srv.preview_unknown: The page and the program lost track. Press the button again.
err.srv.args_changed: Something changed. Press the button again.
err.srv.spend_off: Paid work is switched off. Only your helper can switch it on.
err.srv.claude_off: Claude is switched off on this computer. Ask your helper to switch it on, or choose a free AI.
err.srv.stale: The program is out of date. Ask your helper to restart it.
err.srv.guard: The page was blocked for safety. Open it from this computer only.
err.srv.no_pack: This plan was not found. Make the story plan first.
err.srv.no_validator: The plan has not been checked yet.
err.srv.h3_missing: The video engine is not installed yet.
err.srv.h3_story_needed: The video plan file is not ready yet. Ask your helper.
err.srv.bad_name: Use small English letters, numbers and _ only (no spaces).
err.srv.spend_refused: The paid check said no. Nothing was started.
err.srv.unknown_job: That work is no longer listed.
err.net.down: The program is not answering. Ask your helper to start it.
err.net.timeout: The program took too long. Try again.
err.generic: Something did not work. The details for your helper are in the box below.
